name: machine-row.html
instructions:
1. Adjust the seat so that your knees are slightly bent and the handles are around chest height. Set the weight to your desired level.
2. Grab the handles with a neutral grip, keeping your arms extended and elbows slightly bent. This is the starting position.
3. Engage your back muscles and pull the handles towards your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
4. Slowly return the handles to the starting position, extending your arms fully while maintaining control. This is one repetition.
5. Perform the desired number of repetitions, keeping your movements smooth and controlled.
